established_facts: The camera wearer used a hammer, mallet, string line, and level for aligning and securing bricks during construction. The evidence shows the use of a hammer (M004, M008, M021, M056), mallet (M013, M050), string line (M003, M014, M018, M039, M049, M054), and level (M051, M052).

evidence.source_content: Camera wearer places bricks on ground, adjusts them with hands, measures placement using string line, and taps bricks into place with hammer.

Camera wearer performs repetitive brick laying with cement application, then digs soil with pickaxe and places brick on gravel with trowel and hammer.
Camera wearer spreads cement on ground and wall using trowel and bucket, pulls string line, places brick on concrete, and smooths concrete around it.
Camera wearer pours cement into gaps between bricks and spreads evenly with trowel, places brick on ground, adjusts it, and taps with mallet.
Camera wearer measures ground with tape measure, places bricks on concrete mixture, adjusts them, and taps into place with mallet.
Camera wearer picks up brick, places it on ground or wall, scoops and spreads cement with trowel, and hits brick with hammer; repetitive trowel handling.
